result.summary: Re-validation failed for SIM-01..SIM-04: integration harness still uses SkipZigTest behavior when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent, and SIM-01 fixture isolation still uses a static tenant UUID.

issues.description: Self-sufficiency gate failed: integration tests can exit via error.SkipZigTest when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent because TestHarness.init returns error.SkipZigTest with message '...skipping integration test' instead of enforcing a hard failure path. This violates Step 3b rule that MUST coverage cannot silently skip on missing infrastructure.
